probes: SELECT count(*) AS capabilities, count(*) FILTER (WHERE char_length(means) > 0) AS with_means FROM edge_bff.capabilities

SELECT capability_key, kind, unit, char_length(means) > 0 AS has_means FROM edge_bff.capabilities WHERE capability_key IN ('admin.manual', 'terminal.presets', 'terminal.layouts_max', 'terminal.presets_max', 'terminal.drawings_max', 'screener.saved_items', 'backtest.queued_jobs') ORDER BY capability_key
SELECT plan_key, count(*) AS grants, string_agg(capability_key || '=' || value::text, ' ' ORDER BY capability_key) AS values FROM edge_bff.plan_capabilities GROUP BY plan_key ORDER BY plan_key
SELECT plan_key, capability_key, value FROM edge_bff.plan_capabilities WHERE capability_key LIKE 'monitor.%' ORDER BY plan_key, capability_key
SELECT plan_key FROM edge_bff.plan_capabilities WHERE capability_key = 'admin.manual'
SELECT plan_key FROM edge_bff.plan_capabilities WHERE capability_key = '*'
SELECT tgname FROM pg_trigger WHERE NOT tgisinternal AND tgname IN ('plan_capabilities_value_check', 'user_capability_overrides_value_check', 'capabilities_kind_fixed') ORDER BY tgname
SELECT user_id, plan_key, status, provider, expires_at FROM edge_bff.subscriptions ORDER BY subscription_id
